name: Leire Pajín - Proposition de résolution (ensemble du texte)
title: REPORT on humanitarian aid in a time of polycrisis – reaffirming our principles for a more effective and ambitious response to humanitarian crises
part_text:
The European Parliament calls on the European Union to keep helping people caught in wars, disasters and hunger, and to protect the aid workers who deliver that help. It asks for more money for aid, including in the next long-term EU budget, and for a bigger share to go directly to local groups. It also asks the EU to put women and girls at the centre of aid, and to do more to make sure the rules of war are respected.

- The EU is asked to spend more on aid and keep a separate aid budget.
- Local groups, especially women-led ones, should get more of the money.
- The Parliament has no power to make this happen; it is a request to the EU Commission and member states.
